Three years ago, I began my journey at HCLTech with excitement and curiosity. Today, as I celebrate this milestone, I look back with gratitude for the experiences, challenges, achievements, and invaluable lessons learned along the way.

A heartfelt thank you to my managers and colleagues for their trust, support, and encouragement throughout this journey. Every experience has helped me grow both professionally and personally.

Here's to new opportunities, greater impact, and many more milestones ahead! 🥂
